method.retriever: hybrid BM25+sqlite-vec RRF, token rerank unless AUDIT_RAG_RERANKER is set
method.recall_at_k_all: Fraction of answerable questions where every gold chunk_id appears in the top k retrieved chunks.
method.mean_recall_at_k: Macro-average of |gold ∩ retrieved@k| / |gold| on answerable questions.
method.mrr: Mean reciprocal rank of the first gold chunk in the retrieved list, on answerable questions.
method.doc_recall_at_k: Fraction of answerable questions where at least one gold doc_id appears in the top k.
method.citation_accuracy: On non-refusal answers, each claim sentence must have a [rank:chunk_id] marker, the chunk must be in the retrieved set, and at least half of the claim's content tokens (min 3, or all if fewer) must appear in the cited chunk. Refusals with no citations score 1.0.
method.faithfulness: Same lexical support test as citation accuracy. This is not an LLM-as-judge score and can miss valid paraphrases.
method.refusal_accuracy: (true refusals + true answers) / N, using must_refuse from the golden set.
method.refusal_rule: The extractive generator also refuses when a proper-noun or identifier token from the question is missing from the retrieved chunks, or when a question asks for an exact dollar/amount loss and the candidate answer has no currency figure. This is lexical, not an LLM judge.

records.question: Why is block.timestamp or a blockhash a weak source of on-chain randomness?
records.answer: # SWC-120: Weak Sources of Randomness from Chain Attributes [3:swc-120#c0] - Using external sources of randomness via oracles, and cryptographically checking the outcome of the oracle on-chain [4:swc-120#c3]. ## Relationships - [CWE-330: Use of Insufficiently Random Values](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/330.html) - EthTrust Security Levels: - [**[M] Sources of Randomness**](https://entethalliance.org/specs/ethtrust-sl/#req-2-random-enough) - [**[M] Document Special Code Use**](https://entethalliance.org/specs/ethtrust-sl/#req-2-documented) [5:swc-120#c2] guesses; constructor() public payable { require(msg.value == 1 ether); } function lockInGuess(bytes32 hash) public payable { require(guesses[msg.sender].block == 0); require(msg.value == 1 ether); guesses[msg.sender].guess = hash; guesses[msg.sender].block = block.number + 1; } function settle() public { require(block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block +10); //Note that this solution prevents the attack where blockhash(guesses[msg.sender].block) is zero //Also we add ten block cooldown period so that a minner cannot use foreknowlege of next blockhashes if(guesses[msg.sender].block - block.number < 256){ bytes32 answer = blockhash(guesses[msg.sender].block); guesses[msg.sender].block = 0; if (guesses[msg.sender].guess == answer) { msg.sender.transfer(2 ether); } } else{ revert("Sorry your lottery ticket has expired"); } } } solidity [6:swc-120#c10]
